title: Faster Inference of Flow-Based Generative Models via Improved Data-Noise Coupling
tldr_zh: LOOM-CFM 跨 minibatch 保存并迭代更新噪声–数据配对，12 NFE 下 FID 比 minibatch OT 低 41–54%。
tldr_en: LOOM-CFM persists and locally refines noise-data assignments across minibatches, cutting 12-NFE FID by 41-54% vs minibatch OT with negligible overhead.
